about.label: 02 / About
about.pullQuote: Civil engineer who crossed into software.
about.bio: I spent years building highway infrastructure — road asset management, construction supervision, maintenance coordination. Then I started automating the paperwork with VBA, then building the tools the industry actually needed. Two years ago I crossed fully into software. I now build production systems from the ground up: a full-stack commerce platform with a real payment terminal, and a browser-based 3D construction monitoring platform that runs the Kabsch alignment algorithm from scratch. DeltaVis is not a pivot away from engineering — it is the extension of it. I also take on freelance projects: if you need a website, an online store, or a custom system built, that is what I do.

deltavis.title: DeltaVis
deltavis.oneliner: 3D construction monitoring platform for civil engineers.
deltavis.description: Load two 3D scans of the same construction site at different dates, align them mathematically using the Kabsch algorithm — Jacobi SVD implemented from scratch, no linear algebra library — measure volumetric differences, and export a professional PDF report. Built for the workflows civil engineers and drone operators actually use.

insumos.oneliner: A dental supply business runs on this — online store, physical payment terminal, loyalty rewards. In production today.
insumos.description: Dual-channel system: online store with MercadoPago Checkout Pro and a physical POS running the MercadoPago Point Smart 2 terminal. FCM push notifications, loyalty rewards with race condition-safe Firestore transactions, multi-role access, and a complete order fulfillment workflow.
